we improve the time bound of the first result by a factor of k−1 for the case of unit-height rectangles, and improve the time bound and approximation factor of the second result by a factor k−2 for any constant k⩿2.

the running time of the known approximation results can be significantly improved by using a more efficient data structure to store the rectangles.
the time complexity of the algorithms for the general case can be reduced significantly from O(nk+2) to O(nlogn) for any integer constant ⩾2.
